label: TP
reason: User-controlled input from getQueryString() flows through URL decoding, then to doSomething() where escapeHtml() sanitizes HTML entities but does NOT sanitize % characters needed for format string attacks. The tainted value reaches response.getWriter().format() which interprets %s/%n/etc. as format specifiers, enabling XSS/format string injection.

evidence.note: User input extracted from query string
escapeHtml() sanitizes HTML but not format specifiers
Tainted value used in format() causing XSS
